Permitted scope: No code, no user data, no user contact, no live service.
Minimum artifact set: Research question, primary hypothesis, invariants check, named author.
Not permitted: Data collection, user testing, external action, sensitive-content simulation using real material.

Permitted scope: Synthetic accounts, fictional content, local execution, no network transmission, no real users.
Minimum artifact set: Minimum viable promise, provisional threat model, proposed data boundary, synthetic scenarios, local-only verification where relevant, provisional stop conditions, technical owner.
Not permitted: Real user data, live matching, public indexing, user-to-user contact, external systems.

Permitted scope: Test environment with synthetic data, server components, controlled APIs, mock integrations.
Minimum artifact set: T1 artifacts plus data-flow diagram, retention hypothesis, access-principles test harness, schema/query scan, system interaction review.
Not permitted: Production users, personal data, sensitive real content, live availability, external messaging, payment, location collection.

Permitted scope: Small, explicitly consenting adult participant study, no production decision impact, bounded research protocol.
Minimum artifact set: T2 artifacts plus study protocol, accessible withdrawal, human-review plan, concrete accessibility criteria, consent contract, privacy review, named halt authority, participant grievance route.
Not permitted: Hidden enrollment, public exposure, production ranking, unbounded retention, silent feature changes, external action.

Permitted scope: Narrow real-user availability with feature flags visible to affected users, bounded audience, live monitoring.
Minimum artifact set: T3 evidence plus independent review, operational retention/deletion test, appeal/correction path, production access-parity evidence, current legal/security review where relevant.
Not permitted: Broad rollout, paid priority, hidden A/B tests, unreviewed data expansion, person-level ranking, payment/value-for-intimacy workflows.
